programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 201
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: AmeriCarna - ELVIS VAULT
programme.desc: The last car Elvis drove the evening he passed was his beloved Stutz Blackhawk. Ray discovers that the car has been preserved and heads to Graceland to check out this iconic piece of American music history. Ray and the team reveal the impeccable preservation of the car at Charlotte Motor Speedway with Rick Hendrick (“Mr. H”) and, arguably Elvis Presley’s biggest fan, Dale Earnhardt Jr. While at Graceland, Ray and the team also get an exclusive look at the paneled station wagon Elvis used to get in and out of Graceland in disguise. It’s an intimate look at the King’s incredible automobiles and their secrets that only Elvis knew.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - DISCOVERIES IN JERSEY
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - BREAK UP TO MAKEUP
programme.desc: From break up to make up, Jeff Gordon and Ray reunite to go on a quest to find their Chevrolet Monte Carlo that claimed victory in their final race together at Phoenix, AZ in 1999. John Bickford, Jeff Gordon’s stepdad, makes the call that reunites the old team. Jeff and Ray look to bum parts off their boss, Rick Hendrick, to make their vision a reality: get the car, replace the parts as they were, make it run and get it to auction.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - BATTLE FOR ROME
programme.desc: One of the greatest battles in NASCAR history was Hall of Famer Richie Evans and rival speedster Jerry Cook. Ray is determined to uncover and revive the cars that made these men famous.Ray purchases one of Richie’s original #61 modifieds from Jimmy Spencer and restores it to its original glory while simultaneously building a replica of Jerry Cook’s #38. Throughout the build process, Ray uncovers stories about these legends through the eyes of guys who were in Rome, NY to witness it firsthand, like Robin Pemberton and Steve Hmiel.Both cars will hit the track at Martinsville, site of one of the greatest races in modified history and the tragic death of Richie Evans himself. Legends live again, as Ray recreates one of the racing world’s most celebrated rivalries on a track that has seen it all.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - DRAGSTER DIPLOMACY
programme.desc: In 1964, the United States sent a star-studded race team to England to educate them on drag racing. On that team was Bob Keith and his Dos Palmas car. After being lost for over 40 years, Ray uncovers car and puts together a plan to reunite the two once more. The restoration of the car takes an emotional turn with the loss of a friend.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - WOODIE WAGONS
programme.desc: The premiere episode features a dive into the influence cars had on culture of California. From road racing in the 1940’s to the inception of the iconic Woody wagon on the California beach scene, automobiles undoubtedly shaped the West Coast attitude. Ray talks to The Beach Boys frontman Mike Love and surfing icon Laird Hamilton for a glimpse into the cars that are so connected to surfing culture.

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 108
programme.desc: “12hrs. & Running”: Dale turns a surprise 60th birthday party into a challenge to his guests to start 120 of the rarest motorcycles in the world.

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 107
programme.desc: A cross-country race to lay claim to some of the world’s most sought after works specials.

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 106
programme.desc: A vague tip leads Matt and Dale into a WWII era military warehouse and beyond.

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 105
programme.desc: A thousand bulging barns of choppers, bobbers, and board trackers are emptied and on display in the Quad Cities.

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 104
programme.desc: “Yes, Dale there is a 100 Year Old Harley”: Dale hopes his labor of love becomes a prized possession when a six-figure Harley goes to auction.

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 103
programme.desc: “A Motorcycle Crime Story”: The horrific tale of a double murder over money and motorcycles.

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 102
programme.desc: “The Century Race”: Dale believes he found the bike that will help him beat a rival in an annual race of 100 year old motorcycles. But will it run?

programme.title: What's in the Barn - What's in the Barn 101
programme.desc: A California collector gambles on a big payday from his Crocker/Caddy combo.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Detailing a Brand New Car Part 1
programme.desc: Nick Rutter, along with special guest Bruno Massel, walks you through step-by-step on how to perform a waterless wash, clay and polish, applying a sealant, and finishing with a topcoat wax on a brand-new car.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Interior Car Care
programme.desc: Nick Rutter provides valuable tips and techniques for cleaning and rejuvenating your cars interior

programme.title: Truck U - Save the Paint
programme.desc: Bruno takes a trip to Surf City Garage and learns some techniques from the pros that can help you save money on your next project.

programme.title: Truck U - Paid to Play
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno work on a truck that belongs to a tournament fisherman who uses his truck for work and play. It racks up a lot of miles. They are going to hook this boat captain up with some new products that will make his life a lot easier on the road!

programme.title: Truck U - Better Than Stock
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno are working on a 2006 Dodge Ram with a ton of problems…but why just make the repairs? Go better than stock!

programme.title: Truck U - Wheels For Hope
programme.desc: Matt visits the Wheels for Hope Garage in Raleigh, NC and sees first hand how this organization is changing lives.

programme.title: Truck U - Budget Rear End
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno upgrade the Dana 35 rear end in a 2000 Jeep TJ to a much stronger Ford 8.8 one and do it for under $500.

programme.title: Truck U - Warning Lights
programme.desc: Every light on your dashboard means something. Matt and Bruno diagnose and repair a vehicle that came to the shop to them with warning lights.

programme.title: Truck U - Road Ranger
programme.desc: Nobody likes to fix a truck on the side of the road. That’s why there’s roadside assistance. Matt and Bruno take a stock F250 and turn it into a purpose-built Road Ranger.

programme.title: Truck U - Jeep Build-Off Day 1
programme.desc: With two days and a ton of truck parts anything can happen. Matt and Bruno put together build teams to see who can complete the toughest rig.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - SMOKIN JOE
programme.desc: Blues legend Joe Bonamassa is looking for a surprise gift for his parents. With his love of cars and guitars, Joe has to get Ray and Mr. H involved. From Mopar muscle to Mr. H’s man cave to a concert performance from Joe, this episode has a lot of Drive.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - BOARD TRACK BATTLES
programme.desc: In the early 1900s, race tracks built of wood sprang up across the country drawing crowds of 50,000 and more. Ray and Xtreme sports superstar Travis Pastrana break down the Battle on the Boards.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - MODEL T
programme.desc: Ray finds an old T-Bucket that made a 133 mph pass at the Bonneville Salt Flats in 1951. The team brings the Woody Lee T back to life and attempts to match its original speed.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - DAN GURNEY
programme.desc: Ray finds a Gurney Eagle in a garage on Long Island. He wants to put the coveted machine back on the track at Indy to honor Dan Gurney. After intense restoration and scouring the globe for a Gurney-Westlake engine, the Eagle soars again.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - VINTAGE RACING
programme.desc: Ray uncovers the infamous “Brawner Hawk” – from the Dean Van Lines team – that became the breakout car in the career of Mario Andretti. Ray enlists HOF mechanic Jim McGee to restore the vehicle and, along the way, discovers a replica with many of the car’s original parts. After an award winning stop at Concours Amelia Island, the car heads to the 100th running of Indy 500 where Mario Andretti himself gets behind the wheel.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Super Cars at Course d'Elegance
programme.desc: One of a kind cars at Amelia Island Caffeine & Octane.

programme.title: A New Generation Takes over Amelia Island Caffeine & Octane - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane at Ameilia Island have everything from classic to extraterrestrial.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Voices: Blackberry Smoke
programme.desc: A new season kicks off with some big numbers: Featuring the world's fastest C8 Corvette, an overpowered Cortina Mark I, and a Buick Regal with over 1,700 horsepower

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Voices: Bishop Rob Wright
programme.desc: C & O: North America's most diverse car show: Featuring custom Bugs, John Kaase fire breathing '56 Fords, and Chevy Silverados touching 1000HP

programme.title: Brumos Collection with Hurley
programme.desc: C & O Jacksonville: Featuring Hurley Haywood's Brumos Porsches, a street legal Indy car, and a dynamic '60 Olds

programme.title: Brumos Collection with Hurley
programme.desc: C & O Jacksonville: Featuring Hurley Haywood's Brumos Porsches, a street legal Indy car, and a dynamic '60 Olds

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Graffiti Artist KBMER
programme.desc: Jacksonville's C & O's colorful and quirky car culture.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Voices: Sport's Radio Legend, Mike Bell
programme.desc: C & O: North America's greatest car show

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Voices: Killer Mike
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane: North America's greatest car show

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Fuller's Fab 5
programme.desc: Amelia Island's own Caffeine & Octane car show,: Featuring $2,000 Wrek Racing Truck, David Patterson's favorite C&O cars, a plastic Citroen Mehari, and much more.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Generation Amelia
programme.desc: The Concours d'Elegance from Amelia Island: Featuring bomb-proof Conquest Knight XV, '69 Camaro Hagerty Fixer-Upper, and car-enthusiast John Oates.

programme.title: Delta Wing Racer with a Vengance - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: State-of-the-art engineering and passion projects take center stage on this edition of Caffeine & Octane. The revolutionary Delta Wing Racer turns on hot lap after hot lap at Road Atlanta, and driver Katherine Legge offers insight on how “less is more” when it comes to power to weight ratios; the dark world of a graffiti artist paints a picture of a car called Vengeance while the hosts share the eclectic hybrids of machines that make it to Caffeine and Octane with Vengance’s creator Totem.

programme.title: Henry Ford III & Counterfeit Cars - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the ultimate scene and the place to be seen. Even after 12 hours of racing at the Petit Le Mans endurance race, Henry Ford III, the great grandson of Henry Ford the industrial magnate and current member of Ford’s Board of Directors, showed up to take in the sights, address the crowds, and sign a one of a kind Ford Shelby GT350R. The GT350R will hit the road with Operation Hope to encourage young people to study math and science through motorsports; Covert car counterfeiter, Chuck Beck looks for Ford’s approval on his own version of a muscled up Festiva. YouTuber ‘That Dude in Blue’ David Patterson joins Skip and Bryan to get a special look at the motor-based philanthropic outreach and amazing cars that come with it done by John Hope Bryant, friend of Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Go Fast Collections - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Rickey and Bryan race outside of their comfort zones, each competing to find the raddest car collection. Rickey hangs out with classic racer, Ron Green, who shows him the ropes in the ultra light '83 Ralt RT5. Bryan visits a collection of 120 racing motorcycle owned by mechanic and racer Mike McConville. Mike takes Bryan motorcross racing in his backyard after showing off his high horsepowered car collection. Caffeine and Octane alongside Ron Green visit Atlanta's first Concours d'elegance to look at classic cars that have been perfectly maintained for decades.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - The Wrap on the Most Beautiful Cars
programme.desc: Wayne Phears’ Jaguar E-Type was nothing more than a diamond in the rough before the mineral rights attorney took on the basket case. Caffeine & Octane brings viewers the story of how Phears’, through relentless research and determination, restored and reunited the #10 Jag that Enzo Ferrari called “the most beautiful car ever made”; Atlanta Wraps shows how wrapping Corvettes and Lamborghinis can color a car fast. Caffeine and Exotics is featured again to show off the coolest wraps Atlanta can supply.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Panoz Racing & Chasing Chevys
programme.desc: Twenty-five years of hand building record-setting race cars is no easy task. But don’t tell that to Don Panoz who takes on Porsches and Ferraris with his laid back personality and a full-production facility that makes improvised versions of Americas V-8’s; Caffeine & Octane gets an exclusive look at an elusive man’s life long pursuit of everything Chevrolet.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Retrofitting a Psycho Mercury
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane goes old school with Psycho Deville singer and pin striper Walt Richards. Richards has less than a week to hand paint his signature flames on a way cool ’50 Mercury. An introduction to Retrofit Lighting’s trickle down technology - from cars to motorcycles - that will revolutionize how bikes will see and be seen.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Beetles, Bugs, and Buses, Oh My!
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation is tested when over 100 VW’s, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattled into an event. The annual VW Invasion has swarmed C&O, bringing with it Bugs, Beetles, Buses and more by a very dedicated VW fan base.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Big Tigger v. Monster Muscle
programme.desc: Season 1 finishes on a high note when rapper, radio, and ATL TV personality Darian “Big Tigger” Morgan invites Caffeine & Octane into his home. Cameras look past his collection of 500 Michael Jordan shoes to focus their lenses on a one-off motorcycle the 6 – time NBA Champion gave to Tigger as a gift; A second to none, muscle car collection by one of the founders of Monster Energy gets toured by one of our hosts.

programme.title: Exotic Car Hunter - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Vintage Testarossas and Quatra Valve Ferraris don’t just show up on a dealer’s floor, they’re hunted! Adam Merlin, exotic car expert, has spent a lifetime searching for the cars that defined his youth, but nothing is assumed or given in his high stakes game of Risk; A muscle car fiend shows off his private collection to host Skip Smith.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Andrew Jones' Super Jeep
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. Former Atlanta Brave, World Series star, and 10-Time Gold Glove winner Andruw Jones acknowledged the stardom and showed up to show off his 6 wheeled Super Jeep. The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

programme.title: Jekyll and Hide - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country’s greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt ‘59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Big Yellow Taxi
programme.desc: Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Peach State Challengers
programme.desc: Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Lambo Racer
programme.desc: Former Jet Ski Champion Ryan Hardwick has succeeded in everything he’s touched in racing and business, so why not race Lamborghinis! Hardwick has found rapid success with his high tech training methods; he shares his secrets with host Rickey Gadson in this episode of C&O.

programme.title: Boston's (Un)Common Collection - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Daimlers and Morgans, and Citroens, oh my! Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation grows stronger as Bob Boston’s collection, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattles into an event; guest host Katherine Legge explains the competitor to her racing sponsor Acura, Porsche.

programme.title: C&O at the Beach - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Early spring in Jekyll Island, GA is something to behold. Add a few hundred of the country’s coolest rides for Caffeine & Octane at the Beach, and it’s a thing of beauty. Models that blasted the glass ceiling of expectation at the all makes and models show include a hand-built, twin-turbo Tucker, a one-off 1951 Kaiser Drag’N, and a Roadkill Custom known only as Blasphemi!

programme.title: Kenny Roger's Family Values - Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is back at the beach on Jekyll Island with a focus on cars and families. Fathers & sons, with their barn-find Pilot House trucks and Plymouth Satellites, call cars the glue that keeps them bonded together with C&O being the best place to show them off.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - SEMA: Inside Fuller's Head
programme.desc: On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we’ll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn’t always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Motor Masters
programme.desc: Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? Sure, NASCAR pit crews can make the claim, but can a rag tag group of kids with names like Jelly Donut, Butter Bean, and Wonder Woman claim the pit fame? Host Rickey Gadson heads to the Sims Academy to settle a bet. This ultra fast half-hour edition of Caffeine & Octane also includes a builder’s take on an Ultra Four Unlimited Off-Road Racer; Ryan Hardwick joins the gang at Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Viva Cuba!
programme.desc: Demetrio Montalvo likes American music, American food, and especially American cars. Only one problem - Demetrio lives in Cuba. A Visa, bestowed to him from some American friends in high places, lets him travel to the States to search for tough to find automotive parts and attend his favorite car show. Showing up to Caffeine & Octane in a cool caddy is the easy part. Picking parts to take back home presents a unique set of challenges for the Cuban car builder; Formula Drift racer Federico Sceriffo brings the first ever Formula Drift Ferrari to C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Magnus Walker's Secret Porsche Collection
programme.desc: Porsche collector, customizer, and Urban Outlaw, Magnus Walker is a world-wide rock star to fans of the German car company. So, when Caffeine & Octane producers invited him to travel cross country to tell the story of a hidden Porsche collection tangled in a North Georgia Vineyard, they were surprised when he signed on. No sour grapes here, what Walker found at the Wolf Mountain Winery will impress even those with the most refined palette for Porsches.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Exterior Car Care
programme.desc: Nick Rutter provides valuable tips and techniques for properly washing your vehicle to avoid instilling swirl marks

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Restoring A Used Car
programme.desc: Nick Rutter teaches how to restore headlights, clean engine, remove water spots and other tips on a used car

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - 2011 Mustang
programme.desc: Kevin takes us through variable cam timing in Ford’s new 5.0L power plant.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Café Racer Gets Jets
programme.desc: Fuller and Byrd bring back the Café Racer Honda bike and show you how to open up the jets in the carburetor for better performance.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Turbo Technology
programme.desc: We look at the technology behind turbochargers and intercoolers as we install some upgrades on a F250 Super Duty.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Operation Comfort
programme.desc: Bryan takes a trip to San Antonio to teach some of our nations heroes how to weld.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Cold Air, Hot Rod
programme.desc: We tackle an A/C cooling problem on a Toyota Tacoma and introduce you to Kevin’s Hot Rod BMW.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - LSM3
programme.desc: Kevin and Bryan continue the work on Kevin’s LSM3 project.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Inside the Cat
programme.desc: Kevin travels to Indiana to solve the mysteries of the catalytic converter.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage - Cool Tools
programme.desc: Kevin and Bryan show some cool tools and shop tips while working on Kevin’s Hot Rod BMW.

Put Your Car on TV invites car owners to present their cars and have it judged. The owner of the fastest, most beautiful and best sounding car wins a special treat from Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. Among the competitors are a Lamborghini Aventador and a GMC Chevrolet.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: Once more, Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi are on the hunst for the most amazing cars in the world and ask car owners to bring their customized vehicles to Dubai, where it will be awarded points based on speed, style and sound. The car with the points wins a stay at the Sofitel Hotel Dubai Jumeirah Beach for two people. Among the presented cars are a limited edition Mercedes SLS and an Audi R8.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: On Put Your Car on TV people from the Middle East present their tuned vehicles. They are rewarded with points based on its styling, the highest (possible) speed ever driven und naturally also its sound. Whoever receives the most points, wins a luxurious treat from the Sofitel Hotel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. This time, a Lexus GSF, a Ford Mustang and a McLaren MP4-12C are put on the spotlight.

programme.title: Mercedes-AMG GT S Performmaster
programme.desc: Not far from Stuttgart is the home of the tuner Performmaster who specialize in the performance optimization of Mercedes-AMG models. They turned the already more-than-potent GT S sports car into a beast.

programme.title: Beradino
programme.desc: A „bella macchina“, a beautiful car - but not designed by masters like Bertone or Pininfarina. Johannes Paulussen from Neuss in Germany built the Beradino by hand.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The IAA in Frankfurt is the largest motor show in the world. More than 900 exhibitors present their new products in 11 halls and on 14 outdoor areas. Here you can marvel at tomorrow's trends today.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The tuning forge SKN from Benstorf is organising a Dyno Day for the second time. Also: Lorinser refines the Mercedes E 500 Coupé. And: an invitation to Raeder Motorsport.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Patrick Simon tests the Aston Martin Zagato on the Grand Prix circuit. Also: Renault Megane Sport vs. Golf GTI Edition 35. And: the Porsche 997 and 994 on the Nordschleife.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Once a year, Las Vegas hosts the largest car and tuning trade show in the world - the SEMA Show. We show the highlights from hot rods to custom cars.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The car tuner Lorinser looks back on more than 30 years of experience in tuning Mercedes Benz cars. Also: aeroplane vs. Porsche GT3. And: in an Aston Martin on the Nordschleife.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The Essen Motor Show is the event for automobile and motor sports enthusiasts. Over 300,000 visitors flock here every year and bring the hallowed halls to a boil.

programme.title: Porsche Ruf RT35
programme.desc: Ruf RT35 may look like a Porsche, but it really isn't. Since 1981, the Ruf company in Pfaffhausen, Germany, has been recognized as an independent manufacturer. But the basis for its vehicles comes exclusively from Porsche. A Ruf is even faster and more exclusive than a comparable Porsche.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Nowadays the gull-winged classic DeLorean is an automotive investment. Also: 100 dream cars under the hammer at a classic car auction in Switzerland. And: modern classics with investment potential like the Mercedes 190E 2.3 16V.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The BMW 328 'Schlüter' wrote racing history in the 1930s. Today, the unique car is operational again. Also: the TVR 3000M Cosworth is able to scare any Porsche out of its mind. And: a 60 years old Opel Kapitän gets a makeover.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: At the latest since a 1967 Toyota 2000 GT was sold at auction in the USA for 1.2 million dollars, Japanese classic cars have a different status. We present old and youngtimers "Made in Japan".

programme.title: Saab 93 and Saab 99 Turbo
programme.desc: In 1937 an airplane manufacturing company was founded in Sweden that later became the famous car manufacturer Saab. We present two of their iconic car models, the Saab 93 and 99 Turbo.

programme.title: Volvo Laplander 6x6
programme.desc: More extremes are always possible. Volvo's Laplander army vehicle has 6 wheels, 3 axles and provides space for at least 12 soldiers.

programme.title: Harley-Davidson Trio
programme.desc: We took a look at three very different Harley-Davidson models. The versatile Switchback Dyna, the motorized wheelie bike Sportster 72, and the bad-boy motorcycle Softail Slim.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Bentley New Flying Spur and the Rolls Royce Wraith are both an extremely exclusive breed of cars. These luxurious power packs make for an almost transcendental driving experience and deliver the perfect combination of elegance and performance.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: There are names that sound like music in car enthusiasts' ears: the Mc Laren MP4 12C, the Porsche 911 Turbo S and the Mercedes SLS AMG GT are super sports cars that are second to none. We put the pedal to the metal in these exciting and powerful driving machines.

programme.title: COLLISION 5
programme.desc: The interim-GLORY Heavyweight Title will be up for grabs as top ranked heavyweight contender Antonio Plazibat (22-4, 16 KO) collides with the number two ranked Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (24-2-1, 12 KO) in the main event. These teammates will have to put their friendship aside for one night and go head-to-head for GLORY gold. Also on the card are title fights in the Middleweight, Welterweight and Light Heavyweight divisions.

programme.title: GLORY COLLISION 6
programme.desc: The undisputed heavyweight king of kickboxing will be decided in the main event as long reigning champion Rico Verhoeven (60-10, 20 KO) goes up against arguably his most dangerous opponent to date in interim-heavyweight champ Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (25-2-1, 13 KO). Middleweight champ Donovan Wisse (19-1, 10 KO) puts his title on the line against number one contender Michael Boapeah (16-3-1, 7 KO). Wisse has looked unstoppable so far during his title run but now he faces an in-form Michael Boapeah who holds a win over the only man to beat Wisse. The welterweight division sees top ranked stars go head-to-head as Hamicha (40-2, 30 KO) takes on Diaguely Camara (24-4-1, 10 KO) and Jay Overmeer (29-5, 15 KO) meets Chico Kwasi (41-5, 22 KO). It’s also an important evening at middleweight with Serkan Ozcaglayan (45-8, 36 KO) colliding with Ulric Bokeme (31-4, 17 KO) and the recently debuted Iliass Hammouche (33-6, 7 KO) facing Ivan Galaz (58-10-1, 15 KO). A huge featherweight match-up between the number one ranked Abraham Vidales (15-2, 12 KO) and number two ranked Ahmad Chikh Mousa (58-8-1, 28 KO) plus an exciting light heavyweight bout between Ibrahim El Bouni (41-8-1, 22 KO) and Stefan Latescu (16-2, 7 KO) will round out the main card.

programme.title: COLLISION 7
programme.desc: In the main event, ‘The King of Kickboxing’ Rico Verhoeven put his GLORY world heavyweight title on the line against number one contender ‘The Prince’ Levi Rigters in a hotly anticipated rematch from their GLORY Grand Prix final earlier this year. GLORY light heavyweight world champion Tarik Khbabez will collide with Donegi Abena in a trilogy fight to end their heated rivalry in the co-main event.

programme.title: COLLISION 8
programme.desc: Headlined by a high-stakes trilogy clash between Antonio Plazibat and longtime rival Nordine Mahieddine. Knockout artist Errol Zimmerman takes on former Australian strongman Alex Simon. Also, two explosive four-man, one-night tournaments in the welterweight and light heavyweight divisions—guaranteeing nonstop drama, finishes, and rising contenders.

programme.desc: In the main event, ‘The King of Kickboxing’ Rico Verhoeven put his GLORY world heavyweight title on the line against number one contender ‘The Prince’ Levi Rigters in a hotly anticipated rematch from their GLORY Grand Prix final earlier this year. programme.title: GLORY 100 Last Heavyweight Standing
programme.desc: GLORY 100 features four GLORY world title bouts, four separate four-man one-night tournaments to determine who qualifies for the Last Heavyweight Standing finals, and several key matchups involving some of GLORY’s most popular fighters.

programme.title: Glory 16 Denver SFS
programme.desc: This event featured world title fight for the inaugural Glory Welterweight Championship of Karapet Karapetyan vs. Marc de Bonte as headliner, and 4 Man Heavyweight Contender Tournament.

programme.title: Glory 16 Denver
programme.desc: GLORY 16 slams into Denver with the Welterweight World Title fight, the Heavyweight Contender Tournament, and the debut of USA Martial Arts sensation Pat Barry. Belgian striker Marc de Bonte will battle Armenia's technical machine Karapet Karapetyan for the vacant GLORY Welterweight World Title, guaranteeing a fast, explosive war. At the heaviest end of the GLORY ranks, the big-boys are set to battle it out for a higher ranked spot in the Heavyweight division, and a chance to fight for the Title later within the year. The lineup pits Errol "The Bonecrusher" Zimmerman versus "Bangin" Ben Edwards in a semi-final, and Sergei "The Paratrooper" Kharitonov vs. Anderson "Braddock" Silva in another semi-final. The tournament winner will have to win two fights in one night to claim the prize, and the right to fight for a bigger prize later in the year. Also at Heavyweight, in a tournament reserve match, MMA veteran Pat "HD" Barry returns to his original love of kickboxing, facing another GLORY debutant in the shape of Zack "The Black Warrior" Mwekassa.

programme.title: UFA 480 - Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 2 from the Sala Sporturilor Constantin Jude in Timisoara, Romania. Up first in a kickboxing middleweight bout are Vitalie Matei and Calin Petrisor - the KO Hunter. The main event is a superfight boxing matchup, World Champion Flavius Biea takes on The Hyena Daniel Corbeanu.

programme.title: UFA's Baddest Babes 11
programme.desc: UFA's Baddest Babes episode 11 features SFT's Bianca Sattlemeyer who steps into the cage with Florencia Aleona Greco, Julia Polastri takes on Jessica Cunha and female fightes from Caged Fury Tecia Torres and Rebecca Gruitza take to the cage. Don't miss the featured fighters from Blackeye Barb Honchak versus Roxanne Modafferi.

programme.title: UFA 434 - Red Owl BoxFest XV part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl Boxfest XV part 1 from Houston, Texas. In the first match, Stephen Acosta takes on Brian Soto in a four round super flyweight bout. In the 8 round co-main event undefeated Antonio Perez faces veteran boxer Alex Martin in the Superlight weight division

programme.title: UFA 438 - Red Owl BoxFest XV part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl Boxfest XV part 2 from Houston, Texas. In the Featherweight division, Emmanuel Carrillo Jr. takes on Jordan Najar. In the main event, undefeated Bantamweights Khalid Twaiti and Emanuel Moreno face off in an eight round matchup after an contentious weighin.

programme.title: UFA 349 - Dynamite Fighting Show 20 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 20 part 1 from Bucharest Romania. Watch four kickboxing battles on this episode of UFA. Starting out The Ironman, Denis Ceausu takes on Marius Cimpoeru, then Ali Gokturk Benli faces Andrei Leustean in a Turkey versus Romania bout. Florentin Ionescu takes on the more experienced Mihai Zmarandescu and Omer Pisgin takes on fan favorite The Shephard, Bogdan Nastase.

programme.title: UFA 350 - Dynamite Fighting Show 20 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 20 part 2 from Bucharest Romania with a night of Kickboxing action. Starting off in the heavyweight division, Poland's Dominik Jedrejczyk takes on Romania's Claudiu Badoi in a David versus Goliath fight. Next up, Stefan Orza and Eduard Gafencu look to give fans a fight of the night. In two heavyweight matchups, Florin Ivanoaie faces Cristian Ristea and Ionut Iancu faces Sebastian Cozmanca.

programme.title: UFA 405 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 38 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 38 part 1 from London. Starting off is Dan Gittens stepping into the ring with Will Cairns while Pat Nash faces Danny Fletcher both fighters hoping to get their first Bare Knuckle win. George Hillyard challenges Jimmy Bryan making his Bare Knuckle debut. Watch as two powerhouses fight next as Kamil Sokolowski from Poland takes on Ukranian Volodymyr Skurtu. Also in this episode, Brad Scott and Martyn Grainger face off in a cruiserweight title clash and Marko Martinjak current champion trades punches with Kevin Greenwood in a world light heavyweight title challenge.

programme.title: UFA 406 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 38 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 38 part 2 from London. Starting off this great night of combat, Eryk Majda steps into the ring with Tyrone Eliffe in what is expected to be the fight of the night in this light heavyweight title fight. Next up defending champion Ionel Levitchi faces challenger Tony Shields for the British lightweight title belt. Watch as Liam Rees and Corey Healey take to the ring in a Wales versus Wales contest in a well matched fight for the flyweight title. Plus you won't want to miss the heavyweight bout between Dominic Negus versus Stanlee Wilson.

programme.title: UFA 368 - BKB 35 - Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 35 part 1 from London. This episode starts off with a female match between Romanian Maria Nitescu and Stockholm's Mathilda Wilson, Aaron Sinclair takes on Sultan Ahmed and Tony Barratt steps into the ring with Andrei Nastac making his BKB debut. Also in this episode Corey Healey and Hayden Sherriff are set to meet the challenge while Paul Hilz and Nathan Massey face off in five rounds of BKB.

programme.title: UFA 369 - BKB 35 - Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 35 part 2 from London. In this episode of UFA Jack McLean and Dan Gittens both out of London take to the ring, Benji Robinson meets Gavin Curragh in the ring and Liam Wilson, making his BKB debut, faces Tony Shields. In the co-main event for the World cruiserweight title, CJ Mills and Carl Hobley battle for the belt and in the main event defending champion Jimmy Sweeney (27-4) faces challenger Marley Churcher in a contest for the World Welterweight Title.

programme.title: UFA 428 - Clan Wars 51 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 51 part 1 from Belfast, Ireland. Starting off the night, Jack McCrory squares off against Peter Thompson and in two back to back female fights, Gemma Coghill faces the younger Alexa Pagaduan, while Anneka Bower takes on Lisa Murtagh. Also in this episode Conor McAlister and Kelsey Crossey face off in the catchweight division while Michael Swann and Cian Sweeney take to the cage.

programme.title: UFA 431- Clan Wars 51 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 51 part 2 from Belfast, Ireland. First up in this episode Justis Neun takes on Callum Carville in the catchweight division while Ricardo Dearaujo takes on Andy Wilders in a flyweight bout. Watch as Simon Sackey takes to the cage with Maksims Torskis in the heavyweight division. In a bantamweight contest, Ronan Deegan faces Adrian Barrow and Kelsey Crossey is matched up agains Jason McCourtney for a catchweight bout. In a match for the vacant featherweight Clan Wars title, Jede Paulo fights Nathan Chambers for the belt.

programme.title: UFA 435 - Clan Wars 51 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 51 part 3 from Belfast, Ireland. In the featherweight division Nikola Ivanovic faces Damien McKenna in an MMA matchup and Fynn O'Neill takes on Padraig Irvine in the Catchweight fight. Ash Williams and Ciaran Mullholand take to the cage while Kian McCarton takes on Billy Sutherland for the Flyweight title. In the main event Lethal Shea Leathem challenges Jamie the Spider Monkey McCaugherty in a Welterweight championship title fight.

programme.title: UFA 470 - Up Next Fighting 16 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 16 part 1 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. Starting off this episode is Gebril Chaibi versus Miguel Guzman in a flyweight bout followed by a light heavyweight matchup as Blair Sannoh and Emmanueli Adzoh step into the cage. In the main event, Anthony "The Bully" Romero takes on Ricardo Diaz, the Brazillian veteran, for the vacant UNF Bantamweight title.

programme.title: UFA 474 - Up Next Fighting 16 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 16 part 2 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. In ther first bout, Angel Becerra steps into the cage with undefeated Carson Dohan. In the lightweight division, veteran Darion Champman looks to stop Diego Perez' three bout winning streak. Up next grappler Joe Murphy returns to the cage for a match against boxer Luciano Ramos in a catchweight bout.

programme.title: UFA 479 - Up Next Fighting 16 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 16 part 3 from the Commerce Hotel and Casino in Southern California. Young prospect Joseph Rodriguez looks to keep his undefeated record intact against Jesse Langarica making his pro debut in a catchweight bout. In the main event, it's a battle for the UNF featherweight title, as UFC veteran Francisco Rivera takes on UFC hopeful Jesse Strader.

Bouts include SFT: Bianca Sattelmayer versus Florencia Greco, TuffNUff: Roma Pawelek versus Aspen Ladd, NAAFS: Tecia Torres versus Rebecca Gruitza, SFT: Julia Polastri versus Jessica Cunha, BTC: Lindsay Garbatt versus Rayanne Dos Santos and SFC: Lainey Nations versus Stormie Kilgore

programme.title: UFA 342 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 32 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 32 part 1 from London. In the flyweight devision, Salim Jamshidi and Joe Fitzpatrick, both making their pro BKB debut, battle for the win. Stanlee Wilson faces Tony Barratt, Reece Murray takes on the much more experienced Jonny Lawson, Danny Meins goes head to head with Tony Meeham and Martyn Grainger faces Eryk Majda in the Cruiserweight division.

programme.title: UFA 343 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 32 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 32 part 2 from London. Steven Evans takes on Matty Moore in a Wales versus Ireland fight in the middleweight division. Beau Besley faces Michael Devine in a featherweight clash, Lawrence Tracey and Kevin Greenwood match up in a light-heavyweight bout, Scott McHugh takes on Aaron McCallum in a British Bantamweight title fight. In the main event Jimmy Sweeney takes on Kearon Thomas in the lightweight division.

programme.title: UFA 412 - Centurion FC 20 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centruion Fighting Championship 20 part 1 from Sao Paulo Brazil. A female fight starts this episode with Geisa Veloso versus Beatriz Ferreira. Fernando Henrique squares off against Hugo Paiva both with seven wins under their belt. Also in an extreme boxing match, Victor Xavier faces Rafael Silva.

programme.title: UFA 413 - Centurion FC 20 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centruion Fighting Championship 20 part 2 from Sao Paulo Brazil. This episode features the semi-finals and finals of the four man grand prix tournament. Fighting in the tournament are Itamar Junior versus Marcio Oliveira and Leonardo Limberger versus Lucas Marques. In the heavyweight division Jhonny Pereira and Wildemar Santos trade punches and Andre Borges takes to the cage with Willian Batista in a welterweight fight. In the main event the Centruion Heavyweight belt is up for grabs as Eduardo Neves and Roggers Souza faceoff.

programme.title: UFA 415 - Red Owl XIII part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl BoxFest XIIi part 1 from The Owl's Nest in Houston. In this episode Bre'yon Gorham (17-0) takes on Alan Ayala (11-4) each with a heafty number of knockouts in this Houston versus Guadalajara matchup. In the main event returning fighter Oscar Perez steps into the ring with Christian Medina for 8 rounds of boxing.

programme.title: WPBL 2026 - Hyderabad vs Delhi - Day 6 Tie 1
programme.desc: Experience the electric atmosphere at Mumbai’s Jio World Garden as the high-stakes battle for the top four intensifies between the Hyderabad Superstars and Delhi Dilwale. With legendary co-owner Sunil Gavaskar watching from the sidelines, the Dilwale look to maintain their winning streak against a fiercely aggressive Hyderabad squad known for their wild celebrations and relentless energy. This tie features a series of high-octane clashes, from the strategic precision of Shawn Mendes and Alejandra Lopez in women’s singles to the "grueling" 15-minute sprints of elite doubles play. As the "Band of Honor" leaderboard hangs in the balance, every rally becomes a desperate fight for survival in one of the world's most prestigious pickleball arenas.

programme.title: Semifinals - Virginia vs. Florida
programme.desc: Witness a clash of collegiate giants as the University of Virginia and the University of Florida battle for a spot in the finals at Performance Pickleball RVA. The intensity is at an all-time high after Florida's grueling "dream breaker" victory over NC State to reach this stage. Elite talent takes center stage, featuring former D1 tennis stars like Laura Font and Norwegian standout Martinez Sunstein facing off against Virginia’s deep roster of defending champions. From powerful serves to tactical kitchen play, every point counts in this high-stakes quest for a championship bid.

programme.title: NCPA San Diego Regional 2025 - Collegiate Team Match - GCU vs. Hawaii
programme.desc: We are live from the Barnes Tennis Center in San Diego, California, for Week 3 of the NCPA San Diego Regional 2025. This thrilling collegiate team match features Grand Canyon University (GCU) taking on the University of Hawaii. The broadcast picks up in the heat of the action during a crucial mixed doubles game, with GCU leading. Watch as the match extends into a dramatic Sudden Death Dreambreaker (Game 7) to decide the winner. The episode highlights the unique collegiate format where every point counts towards seeding for the National Championship. Key players include Hawaii's Tristan Simmons and Tama, battling against GCU's Tanner and Hannah. The match concludes with a high-stakes finish that determines who moves forward in bracket play.

programme.title: Picklebowl 2023 – Mixed Doubles – Frazier & Tuazon vs Tereschenko & Pardoe
programme.desc: Dylan Frazier and Ritchie Tuazon meet Irina Tereschenko and Connor Pardoe in a high-stakes mixed doubles match at Picklebowl 2023. Set against the backdrop of this annual charity event, the match features four seasoned competitors known for their precision, quick reflexes, and court awareness. Expect fast-paced exchanges, smart teamwork, and big momentum swings as both teams battle for bragging rights and a good cause. Blending professional play with the spirited energy of Picklebowl, this match is a crowd favorite you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: WPBL 2025 - Mumbai vs. Bengaluru - Day 7 Tie 1
programme.desc: Day 7 of the World Pickleball League brings a critical and dramatic game between Mumbai Pickle Power and the Bengaluru Jawans. The game begins with a highly anticipated Men's Singles match featuring Mumbai's American star Brandon Lane against Bengaluru's Jack Foster. The match lives up to the hype, showcasing fierce action.

programme.title: US Open 2025 - Mixed Pro Doubles - Kao/DeHeart vs. Fudge/Munro
programme.desc: Watch a thrilling Mixed Pro Doubles pickleball match between the top-seeded team of Megan Fudge and Jack Munro against Peichuan Kao and Ryler DeHeart. Megan Fudge is a highly-ranked professional player who previously played tennis at the University of Illinois, where she met her husband and partner, Ryler DeHeart. DeHeart is a former professional tennis player who is left-handed. Their opponents are Peichuan Kao, a professional pickleball player who won gold at the APP Fort Lauderdale Open, and Jack Munro, a young pro who was the youngest to become a professional at age 12.

programme.title: 2026 Pickleball US Open – Friday Match 4 - Fudge/Sewing vs. Stewart/Oshiro
programme.desc: Friday Match 4 from the 2026 Franklin US Open Pickleball Championships features Megan Fudge and Sofia Sewing facing Kat Stewart and Bobbi Oshiro in a competitive doubles showdown. programme.title: US Open 2024 – Women’s Split Pro Doubles Semifinal – Courter & Humberg vs Frantova & Karges
programme.desc: Sheri Courter and Mari Humberg take on Martina Frantova and Christine Karges in this Women’s Split Pro Doubles Semifinal match at the 2024 US Open Pickleball Championships. With fast-paced exchanges, sharp angles, and tactical precision, both teams battle for a spot in the finals on the prestigious Zing Zang Championship Court in Naples, Florida. This high-stakes match features standout teamwork and thrilling rallies from some of the sport’s most skilled competitors.

programme.title: US Open 2025 - Mixed Pro Double - Agassi/Waters vs. HuynhMcClain/Yang
programme.desc: Witness an unexpected and electrifying Mixed Pro Doubles showdown from the Minto US Open Pickleball Championships in Naples, Florida! Originally scheduled for a back court, this highly anticipated match featuring Andre Agassi and Anna Leigh Waters was moved to Championship Court due to overwhelming crowd demand, creating an unforgettable atmosphere. Relive every moment as these top players battle it out in a thrilling display of professional pickleball. Don't miss the action from East Naples Community Park – the epicenter of pickleball!

programme.title: Semifinals - Utah Valley vs. GCU
programme.desc: The DUPR Collegiate Pickleball Utah Super Regional semifinals deliver high-octane action as powerhouse Utah Valley University (UVU) goes head-to-head with Grand Canyon University (GCU). Watch as UVU's Sophia Thompson and Ali Evanson attempt to protect their undefeated record against GCU’s Brenna Murray and former BYU tennis star Dodo Kong in a hard-hitting women’s doubles opener. The intensity shifts to the men's doubles as UVU's Tyler Miller and Thatcher Schwendimann face a strategic challenge from GCU's Adam Jones and Artur Fonseca, a beach tennis specialist from Brazil. Watch as these top British players battle through tight rallies and momentum swings in a must-see semifinal clash.

programme.title: WPBL 2026 Grand Final - Chennai vs Delhi - Day 13 Tie 1
programme.desc: The grand finale of the World Pickleball League Season 2 descends upon Mumbai’s Jio World Garden for an unforgettable clash of titans between the Chennai Super Champs and Delhi Dilwale. Witness the technical mastery of Rika Fujiwara as she faces off against Alejandra Lopez in a high-stakes women’s singles match that sets the tone for the entire championship. The intensity reaches a fever pitch during a mixed doubles "masterclass" featuring Max Mansoor and Trang Huynh, which commentators hailed as the potential "rally of the season". With the "Band of Honor" and the ultimate league trophy on the line, every strategic "Pickle Play" and nerve-wracking volley contributes to an atmosphere so electric the crowd and commentators alike are left "going berserk".

programme.desc: The atmosphere is electric as the top-seeded Indiana Hoosiers clash with the relentless Utah Valley Wolverines in a high-stakes quarterfinal showdown. programme.desc: Experience the electrifying atmosphere of the Joola Showcase at the NCPA Nationals, where the top 12 collegiate athletes in America converge for a high-octane battle between Team Hyperion and Team Perseus. The match features a Racing pace with a unique sudden-death format that forces players to switch between singles, doubles, and mixed rounds every three points. Watch as these elite competitors demonstrate incredible Skills at the kitchen line, including precision dinks and aggressive "off the bounce" initiates that define modern collegiate play. In a Freestyle display of athleticism, stars like Jaden Broderick and Alexandra McDonald trade "exhibition-style" points in a quest to secure premium Yola paddles for their victory. This high-energy showdown serves as the ultimate prelude to Championship Sunday, proving that the future of pickleball is brighter than ever.

programme.title: WPBL 2026 - Pune vs Mumbai - Day 10 Tie 2
programme.desc: Experience the electric intensity of the "Maharashtra derby" as local rivals Pune United and Mumbai Pickle Power clash at the Jio World Garden in a match hailed as one of the season's best. Mumbai ignites the home crowd with a dominant early lead, fueled by Jada Bui’s emotional victory over a "fearful" Katie Morris and a clinical masterclass from Brandon and Glauca Carvajal Lane in mixed doubles. However, the tide turns in a dramatic "tale of two halves" as Pune United mounts a stunning comeback. Witness the high-power precision of Bolin Bako as he derails Max Green’s momentum, sparking a relentless surge that sees Pune sweep the final three matches to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat. This tie is a masterclass in team resilience and tactical pressure under the lights in Mumbai.

In this high-stakes "penultimate tie," the defending champion Bengaluru Jawans face off against a hungry Delhi Dilwale squad led by coach Wesley Gabrielsson. Witness a clash of styles as the dominant Katerina Stewart, who has lost only one match all season, battles the passionate Alejandra Lopez in a critical women's singles opener. Tactical brilliance is on full display as Max Mantor and Trang Huynh attempt to dismantle the Jawans' defense in a high-scoring mixed doubles "exhibition". However, the momentum shifts as Tampieri, fueled by a passionate home crowd, adjusts her strategy to target Linton’s backhand and level the match.

Watch as international stars like Delhi’s Max "Purple Jesus" Manthao and Chennai’s Hwang Nam Lee—a former Wimbledon junior doubles champion—bring world-class precision to the court. With celebrity co-owner Samantha cheering from the sidelines and strategic masterclasses from coach Wesley Gabrielsson, this tie features a gauntlet of intense Women’s Singles, Men's Singles, and high-speed Doubles matches. programme.title: Ohio State University vs. University of Florida
programme.desc: The atmosphere reaches a fever pitch as the Ohio State Buckeyes and Florida Gators face off in a high-stakes battle for the 2023 DUPR Collegiate National Championship. Referee Kate Johnson sets the tone early, enforcing strict regulations on net contact and service line precision to ensure every point is earned through pure grit. Spectators will witness an intense racing flow as players scramble for kitchen control, showcasing the technical skills required to navigate high-speed volleys and strategic double bounces. With Florida utilizing critical timeouts to regroup against Ohio State’s relentless pressure, the match transforms into a display of freestyle athleticism and raw competitive spirit. Don’t miss a second of the action as these elite collegiate athletes fight to keep their championship dreams alive.

programme.desc: Live from The Picklr in Noblesville, this NCPA Indiana Regional 2025 matchup features a critical battle between the University of Wisconsin-Madison and Purdue University. With eight national bids and $5,000 in prize money on the line, the stakes are high as the 16th-seeded Purdue takes on the 17th-seeded Wisconsin in a best-of-seven format.The match kicks off with Gender Doubles, where Wisconsin’s duo of Noah and Sarah Sowinski showcase dominant net play and quick hands against Purdue’s Caleb Yang and Trevor Ju. Watch for standout moments, including an incredible Ernie from Wisconsin and strategic adjustments in the Mixed Doubles games involving Colton Thielman and Elena Schlichte.

Set against the scenic backdrop of Sea Island, Georgia, this unique event blends elite pickleball play with charity and college pride. Expect explosive rallies, pinpoint accuracy, and powerful serves in this high-energy exhibition that showcases the crossover appeal of pickleball.
